name: What types of skylights are available, and how do I choose the right one for my home?

mainEntity.name: What types of skylights are available, and how do I choose the right one for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Various skylight types exist, including fixed, ventilating (manual or electric), and tubular daylighting devices. The right choice depends on your specific needs: fixed skylights are ideal for pure light infusion, while ventilating options allow for passive cooling and air circulation. When integrating skylights into a larger renovation, AKN Design Group's integrated design-build process helps you assess factors like room function, ceiling structure, and desired aesthetic to select the optimal type and placement for enhancing your home's design and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Skylights vary from fixed to ventilating types. Choosing depends on room function, ceiling structure, and desired light or ventilation, which we help determine during our design process.
